data.name: Sadiaht
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Sidrah’ meaning ‘moon’, and ‘At’ meaning ‘lady’ or ‘female’. It is a beautiful and elegant name inspired by the moon, representing grace and beauty.
